parsed.explanation: Tier-1 exposures dominate. The division enacts a 2025 birth-sex facilities ban in state buildings and schools with no effective remedy, and a 2021 law lets businesses deny service to LGBTQ people on religious grounds — both traveller-facing universal exposures. State law offers no gender-identity discrimination ban and its hate-crime law excludes gender identity, leaving only thin national backstops. The March 2026 high-court ruling closing birth-certificate marker change and the 'worst for anti-trans legislation' ranking signal a hostile, worsening institutional climate; incarcerated trans people face possible solitary confinement. The parent regime adds border document scrutiny (X markers ended, discrepancy → refusal or lifetime fraud finding), so discovery at entry carries real consequences. Dockets show some contested measures and a settlement apology, but nothing documented as changing the operative rules. No criminalisation of presentation itself keeps this above the 0.25 tier.
